name: bazar-solidario
description: Bazar Solidário Digital — Projeto de Extensão V (UNI-RN)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bazar/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @bazar/api" "npm run dev -w @bazar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bazar/shared && npm run build -w @bazar/api && npm run build -w @bazar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bazar/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bazar/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
